summary: Enlivex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a securities purchase agreement for a $400M private placement of ordinary shares priced at $5.00-$6.00 per share, representing a 17.4%–40.8% premium to the July 27 closing price. The investor may fund with US dollars, USDT, USD Coin, or RAIN tokens; the transaction includes a 36-month issuer put right for up to $400M additional shares on the same terms. Closing requires shareholder approval under Nasdaq rules and Israeli law. Proceeds support a treasury strategy around the Rain protocol prediction markets plus clinical programs. Watch shareholder vote and closing timing; risk-arb centers on premium pricing and shareholder approval risk. Equivalent to a US-registered direct offering.
